apps.momits.Electrip.desktop CC0-1.0 GPL-3.0+ ​momits_AT_users.sourceforge.net Electrip https://electrip.sourceforge.net Control your model railroad using gamepads!
Electrip is an easy-to-use, small software that lets you control your model railroad with gamepads via the SRCP protocol. Electrip is very easy to use and well-documented. It supports a sophisticated simulation of loco sounds, including driving sounds, sound functions and event-triggered sounds. Electrip allows to control the speed of locos to scale in the model world with a clever visual speed mapping. Locos can also be exported and imported as archives together with their configured sounds.
